name: Courtyard by Marriott Penang
short_description: Select-service Courtyard high-rise on Jalan Macalister in central George Town, Penang. ~199 modern rooms and suites with city and Straits views, a high-floor infinity pool, 24-hour gym, and the Penang Kitchen all-day restaurant. Malaysia's first Courtyard-branded hotel.
ai_summary: Courtyard by Marriott Penang is a modern select-service tower on Jalan Macalister, a food-lined street in central George Town, and was the first Courtyard-branded hotel in Malaysia when it opened in 2020. Its roughly 199 rooms and suites are consistently described by independent reviewers as clean, contemporary and spacious, with marble bathrooms, smart TVs and high-floor views over the city and the Straits of Malacca. The standout amenity is a high-floor outdoor pool with sweeping skyline views (especially at night), backed by a 24-hour fitness center and sauna. Dining centers on the Penang Kitchen all-day restaurant, praised for both Western and local dishes at breakfast, plus the Gin Library bar on an upper floor. On TripAdvisor the hotel holds about 4 of 5 stars (roughly 320 reviews, ranked around #31 of 194 George Town hotels). Reviewers repeatedly highlight strong value, warm and professional staff, and generous Marriott Bonvoy Elite perks (complimentary breakfast, F&B credit, lounge drinks). Common criticisms are modest Wi-Fi speeds, a compact gym and sauna, and a cramped reception at peak times. The immediate area is business-oriented rather than touristy, but Grab rides reach hawker centers and heritage sites quickly.

core_facts.address: 218D Jalan Macalister, 10400 George Town, Penang, Malaysia
core_facts.neighborhood: George Town (Jalan Macalister / Macalister Road), Penang Island
elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability (select-service upgrade pool)
Bonus points in lieu of breakfast for Platinum Elite and above at hotels without full breakfast service
Enhanced Wi-Fi and a welcome amenity for all Elite tiers

pros: Central George Town location on food-lined Jalan Macalister with quick Grab access to attractions
Modern, clean, spacious rooms with marble bathrooms and high-floor city/Straits views
High-floor outdoor pool with skyline views, plus 24-hour gym and sauna
Strong value and generous Marriott Bonvoy Elite perks (breakfast, F&B credit, lounge drinks)
cons: Modest Wi-Fi speeds noted by multiple reviewers
Compact gym and sauna; reception can feel cramped at peak times
Surrounding blocks are business-oriented rather than tourist-focused
research_highlights: First Courtyard-branded hotel in Malaysia; opened 2020
Penang Kitchen restaurant well reviewed (approx 4.6/5 on TripAdvisor) for local and Western breakfast
Consistent praise across independent blogs for value and staff service
research_watchouts: Distinct from the mainland Courtyard Penang Icon City property (Bukit Mertajam) and from the separate Penang Marriott Hotel — do not conflate reviews or videos
Wi-Fi and service consistency were flagged as weaker points in at least two reviews

faqs.question: Where is Courtyard by Marriott Penang located?
faqs.answer: It is on Jalan Macalister (Macalister Road) in central George Town, Penang Island, about 17 km from Penang International Airport (PEN). The food-lined street offers many dining options, and Grab rides reach heritage sites and hawker centers in minutes.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities does the hotel offer?
faqs.answer: The all-day Penang Kitchen restaurant serves local and international dishes and is well regarded for breakfast, and there is a Gin Library bar on an upper floor. Facilities include a high-floor outdoor pool with city views, a 24-hour fitness center, and a sauna.

reviews.title: Review: Courtyard Penang (King Room)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Titanium Elite member two-night stay in a spacious 69 sqm King Room. Praises modern decor, pool, sauna and generous elite perks that felt near half-board. Downsides: Grab-reliant location, limited breakfast and weak Wi-Fi.

reviews.title: Review: Courtyard Penang
reviews.author: Ricky Zhang
reviews.summary: Booked for just 5,000 points, the reviewer calls it exceptional value: modern rooms, a 21st-floor marble-bathroom king, a high-floor pool with skyline views and a gym with spa. But surroundings are business-oriented and not luxury.

reviews.title: Penang Hotel Review: Courtyard by Marriott Penang
reviews.author: Angie S.
reviews.summary: Family review rating the Macalister Road hotel highly for location and cleanliness, with quick Grab access. Praises adjoining Family Escape rooms, Penang Kitchen dishes, rooftop pool, breakfast, Kids Eat Free and warm staff.

reviews.title: 【Review】Courtyard by Marriott Penang Malaysia
reviews.author: LivingHotel
reviews.summary: Review of a 32 sqm Premier Room in UNESCO George Town praises new furnishings, a high-floor pool and Penang Kitchen dining. Cons: cramped reception, modest Wi-Fi, weak service and a compact gym. Rated 6.5/10; best for Bonvoy members.
